recommendation.rationale: Fund CZE, ESP under the base case: it ranks first among feasible single hubs and pairs by annual incremental contribution (198,099 EUR), within the EUR450,000 capex and seven-FTE hard constraints. Treat this as a supported planning recommendation, not a causal or statistically proven demand forecast; release capex only after the 90-day gates.
recommendation.flip_condition: Reopen before commitment if validated base-volume uplift falls below the selected pair's break-even or if stress contribution turns negative; the exact break-even is in the workbook and report.

quality.source_room: Frozen local snapshot collected from TOOLING.md URL; not a live client account.
quality.client_data_status: All order, return, cost, option and policy inputs are synthetic; World Bank and ECB observations are public official snapshots.

accounting.grain: one canonical order_id / one SKU row; one canonical return_id
accounting.revisions: highest numeric revision wins; corrections replace whole rows
accounting.duplicates: identical rows removed before revision selection
accounting.fx: ECB arithmetic mean of available 2025 business-day observations; local currency units per EUR; EUR=1
accounting.rounding: individual gross sales, refunds, net COGS, fulfillment and contribution rounded half-up to cents per order before sum
accounting.returns: valid returns allocated to original sale month; distinct return IDs additive; restocked units recover original unit cost only

limitations: ECB reference rates are analytical translation assumptions, not transaction-level FX; the archive includes later dates than the 2025 analysis.
World Bank population and GDP per capita are context only, not direct evidence of replacement-assembly demand or hub causality.
Scenario arithmetic is a synthetic planning model without customer interviews, freight-lane validation, local labor quotes, or a discounted cash-flow model.
Return receipts after the inclusive cutoff and returns linked to ineligible or orphan orders are not included in 2025 results.
